 CARTER FAITH UNVEILS “STILL THE SPARROW SINGS,” WRITTEN AND PERFORMED FOR HER ROLE IN NETFLIX’S HEARTLAND
 MARKS FAITH’S ACTING DEBUT ALONGSIDE JESSICA CHASTAIN, FILM PREMIERES NOVEMBER 13 
 NOMINATED FOR NEW ARTIST OF THE YEAR AT 2026 
 30 OCTOBER 2026 (TORONTO, ON) –  Breakout star  Carter Faith  shares a new song, “ Still The Sparrow Sings ,” today via  Gatsby Records/MCA ; listen  HERE  and watch the performance video filmed at Nashville’s The Bluebird Cafe  HERE . Written and performed by Faith for  Netflix ’s upcoming original movie,  Heartland , the track is the second release from the film’s official soundtrack, out  November 13  (pre-order/pre-save  HERE ).
 Heartland  marks Faith’s acting debut alongside Academy Award-winner  Jessica Chastain  and premieres exclusively on Netflix on  November 13 (watch the trailer  HERE ). The film follows Faith’s first-ever  CMA Award  nomination for  New Artist of the Year , which will be presented live on ABC on Wednesday, November 18 at 8:00pm ET.
 An acclaimed live performer, Faith joined Chris Stapleton, Kacey Musgraves and Shaboozey on tour this fall and is currently out on her own  Cherry Valley Forever Tour , which includes stops at San Diego’s House of Blues, Saint Louis’ Old Rock House and Chicago’s Joe’s on Weed Street, among others. See below for complete tour routing.
 The new dates follow the release of  Cherry Valley Forever , the deluxe edition of Faith’s acclaimed debut album  Cherry Valley . Released this summer, the expanded project adds five new tracks to the original record, including “ Nothin’ Better To Do ” with Wyatt Flores and “ Pearl Handled Pistol ” with Laci Kaye Booth and Baby Nova. The deluxe arrived on the heels of Faith’s historic ACM Album of the Year nomination for  Cherry Valley —the first debut album to earn a nod in the category in a decade, following Chris Stapleton’s  Traveller  in 2016.
 Cherry Valley  is one of the most-lauded country debuts in recent memory:  Rolling Stone  named it their #1 country album of the year and #17 on their  Best 100 Albums of 2025  alongside accolades from  Billboard ,  Stereogum ,  NPR Music ,  The Hollywood Reporter  and many more.
 Faith made her late-night TV debut earlier this year with a performance on  The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon , after appearing with Fallon for their 2025 holiday single “ Ugly Sweater .”
 Cherry Valley  was shaped over two years of writing with longtime producer Tofer Brown before the pair entered the studio in 2024 to record. During that time, Faith was steadily rising through country music, signing with MCA and Universal Music Publishing Group, making more than a dozen appearances at the Grand Ole Opry, earning hundreds of millions of streams, and being named an Amazon Music Breakthrough Artist and  Music Row ’s 2025 Discovery Artist of the Year. Following her Stagecoach debut and touring runs with Ella Langley and Carly Pearce, Faith joined Little Big Town’s Karen Fairchild at the 18th Academy of Country Music Honors for a duet of “Lies Lies Lies,” written by ACM Songwriter of the Year Jessie Jo Dillon, while also sharing stages with Post Malone, Jelly Roll, George Strait, Little Big Town, and Noah Cyrus across the country.
